title: Advisory Authoring Assistance
objective: Permit optional AI or deterministic assistance for shot, layout and dialogue alternatives plus asset discovery through existing proposal-only authority, while ensuring suggestions never silently alter authored work or hidden/canonical state.
acceptance: Assistance outputs have stable proposal identity, explicit proposal kind and explicit target/source references.
Deterministic and AI-assisted proposal origins remain distinguishable and optional; provider-off deterministic assistance remains usable.
Shot/layout/dialogue alternatives and asset-discovery suggestions remain proposals only and never silently apply to authored SAA state.
Dialogue/narrative suggestions preserve owner/source references and do not become canonical dialogue or narrative truth.
Asset-discovery suggestions reference existing governed ARI resources/candidates without creating, registering or fabricating canonical asset/provenance state.
Stale, missing, unavailable or incompatible proposal inputs fail the affected suggestion closed without silent rebasing, fallback or semantic rewriting.
SAA-20 and later golden-proof/collaboration/share/publication behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-19 owns proposal-only advisory metadata; it does not gain mutation authority over authored SAA, Dialogue, Character, Scene, ARI, AAI or narrative state.
AI use is optional; no paid cloud or provider call is required for deterministic assistance.
Proposal acceptance/application, if later authorized by an owning edit command, is outside SAA-19 automatic authority and cannot occur silently.
No canonical asset registration, sharing/publication, external upload or final Creator integration authority is granted.
SAA-20 remains blocked until verified SAA-19 closeout.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-19.
